summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K announcing that Phase II MAvERIC study results for CardiolRx in recurrent pericarditis were accepted for publication in the Journal of the American Heart Association. The filing reports clinical findings and enrollment progress in the ongoing Phase III MAVERIC trial. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is involved. This is a routine business update on clinical trial results, not a special situation.
